decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed telecommunication installation, by reason of its siting size and appearance, would have a detrimental impact on the visual amenities of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area and the setting of the listed buildings in Gunnersbury Park. Furthermore the siting of the lamppost would have and adverse impact upon the street scene leading to visual clutter. This is contrary to policies ENV.1.1 (New Development), ENV1.2 (High Buildings or Structures Affecting Sensitive Areas), ENV.2.2 (Conservation Areas) ENV.B.2.5 (Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building) and ENV1.7 (Telecommunications) of the unitary development plan.
description: Erection of a 11.8 metre lampost style microcell telecommunications column with a street adjacent to the column at ground level
